# bMintX

> bMintX (https://bmintx.com) is the home of minting in bWalletX. Timestamp what you make (memes, music, videos, art, 3D, books, websites) on Bitcoin (BSV), in your own name, from about a penny for small files, and keep it in your own wallet. Part of bWalletX.

## How it works
1. Make something, with any tool (including AI tools).
2. Open Mint (bMint) in bWalletX, pick the type, add the file and a title. The network cost is shown before you sign.
3. The piece is written to Bitcoin with a timestamp and your key's signature, and is held in your wallet.

## Live
- Minting in bWalletX (bMint): art & photos, music, videos, 3D models, books & PDFs, one-page websites; one of a kind or numbered collections.
- Cost shown before signing; pieces held in the user's own wallet.
- Tickets, coins and memecoins from the same Mint card (in editions that include them).
- bPics photo minting.

## Coming
- A public vault page on bmintx.com.
- Auto-mint from AI tools such as Grok.
- Code and games.

## Small print
Minting is a timestamp and proof of publication by a key, not a copyright registration or legal guarantee of ownership.
